name: tbc-kit-workspace

scripts.build:core: npm run generate:v1-candidate && npm run generate:core-types && npm run generate:core-validators && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && esbuild packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/src/release.ts --outdir=packages/core/dist/esm --bundle --external:@noble/hashes/* --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --sourcemap && esbuild packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/src/release.ts --outdir=packages/core/dist/cjs --bundle --external:@noble/hashes/* --format=cjs --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --out-extension:.js=.cjs --sourcemap
scripts.build:tbc-engine: npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/tbc-engine/tsconfig.json && esbuild packages/tbc-engine/src/index.ts packages/tbc-engine/src/native.ts packages/tbc-engine/src/wasm.ts --outdir=packages/tbc-engine/dist/esm --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/core --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --sourcemap && esbuild packages/tbc-engine/src/index.ts packages/tbc-engine/src/native.ts packages/tbc-engine/src/wasm.ts --outdir=packages/tbc-engine/dist/cjs --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/core --format=cjs --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --out-extension:.js=.cjs --sourcemap
scripts.build:host: npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/host/tsconfig.json && esbuild packages/host/src/index.ts packages/host/src/indexeddb.ts packages/host/src/sqlite.ts --outdir=packages/host/dist/esm --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/core --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --sourcemap && esbuild packages/host/src/index.ts packages/host/src/indexeddb.ts packages/host/src/sqlite.ts --outdir=packages/host/dist/cjs --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/core --format=cjs --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --out-extension:.js=.cjs --sourcemap
scripts.build:provider: npm run generate:v1-candidate && npm run generate:provider-types && npm run generate:provider-validators && tsc -p packages/provider/tsconfig.json && esbuild packages/provider/src/index.ts packages/provider/src/in-memory.ts packages/provider/src/webview.ts --outdir=packages/provider/dist/esm --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/core --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --minify --legal-comments=none --sourcemap --sources-content=false && esbuild packages/provider/src/index.ts packages/provider/src/in-memory.ts packages/provider/src/webview.ts --outdir=packages/provider/dist/cjs --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/core --format=cjs --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --out-extension:.js=.cjs --minify --legal-comments=none --sourcemap --sources-content=false
scripts.build:wallet-standard: tsc -p packages/wallet-standard/tsconfig.json && esbuild packages/wallet-standard/src/index.ts --outfile=packages/wallet-standard/dist/esm/index.js --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/provider --external:@wallet-standard/core --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --minify --legal-comments=none --sourcemap && esbuild packages/wallet-standard/src/index.ts --outfile=packages/wallet-standard/dist/cjs/index.cjs --bundle --external:@tbc-wallet/provider --external:@wallet-standard/core --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --legal-comments=none --sourcemap
scripts.build:kit: npm run build:host && npm run build:provider && node packages/kit/scripts/build-legacy-page-bootstrap.mjs && tsc -p packages/kit/tsconfig.json && node packages/kit/scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:kit: npm run build:tbc-engine && npm run build:kit && node --test packages/kit/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:tbc-engine: npm run build:tbc-engine && node --test packages/tbc-engine/test/*.test.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path packages/tbc-engine/rust/Cargo.toml -p tbc-engine-core --offline --locked && npm run build:host && node packages/tbc-engine/scripts/check-rust-runtime-artifacts.mjs
scripts.test:example:minimal: npm run build:example:minimal && node scripts/check-example-boundary.mjs && node --test examples/third-party-wallet-minimal/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:sdk-consumer: npm run build:host && npm run build:tbc-engine && npm run build:provider && npm run build:wallet-standard && node scripts/check-sdk-consumer.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:core-types && npm run check:provider-types && npm run check:provider-validators && npm run build:core && npm test && npm run test:core && npm run test:tbc-engine && npm run test:host && npm run test:provider && npm run test:wallet-standard && npm run test:example:minimal && npm run check:sdk-consumer && npm run check:core-portability && npm run check:host-portability && npm run check:provider-portability && npm run check:wallet-standard-portability && npm run check:conformance && npm run test:kit

description: TBC Wallet Standard（TWS）定义两层开放协议：DApp 与钱包之间的 Provider wire protocol，以及标准内核与第三方 Wallet Host 之间的 Integration Port protocol。它的目标是让任意合规钱包在不复制 Turing Wallet UI、Vault 或旧 `window.Turing` 实现细节的前提下，安全支持 TBC 账户、签名和交易能力。
